filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Wed Oct 21 – Thu Oct 22 PT

market_briefing.lede: Sales context is being opened up to outside agents, and model vendors now want to know exactly who those agents serve. Zoom turned its meeting record into a layer any agent can query, while OpenAI and Anthropic both moved to identify the end customers behind apps built on their models.

bullets.text: Meeting data becomes agent infrastructure: on Oct 21 Zoom introduced a Unified Context Layer that links meetings, phone, chat and documents, plus MCP servers and Search & Ask APIs (available now) so Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Slackbot and other MCP agents can query it. My Notes Workflows will turn meeting summaries into follow-up work in Salesforce and Zoom Chat, with ready-made sales workflows (expected October).

Apps built on frontier models now carry end-customer identity duties: OpenAI's updated Usage Policies (effective Nov 20) require routers and gateways that offer direct model access to get OpenAI's approval, and it is introducing SafetyIDs to tell end users apart in investigations. Anthropic launched user profiles (Oct 20) and, on Oct 21, enforcement status fields showing whether one of your end customers has been restricted or banned.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic previews Claude Duet, a proactive agent app
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 21: a standalone iOS, Android and web app on Claude Opus 5.5 that sends a morning brief, watches connected apps, works tasks on its own cloud computer while you're away, and asks before sending, paying, signing or deleting. Waitlist only, for US Pro and Max subscribers; not yet on Team or Enterprise.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI will require approval for model routers and gateways
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 21: updated Usage Policies, effective Nov 20, require services that give direct access to OpenAI models, such as routers or AI gateways, to get review and approval first. Partners that host or resell the models must keep matching safeguards.

biggest_ai_news.title: Claude API version 2026-10-21 and new major SDKs
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 21: new API version plus major SDK and ant CLI releases that send it by default. The SDK releases carry their own breaking changes and move from the MIT License to Apache 2.0.

what_changed.title: Monaco launches Agent Matrix
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist launch). Oct 21: CEO Sam Blond announced Agent Matrix, many goal-seeking agents working together around the clock with one aim, accelerating revenue growth. Early access is by application. Co-founder Shek Viswanathan says it ships Monaco's own prebuilt agents plus the ability to build your own, such as lead routing, inline call and email coaching in Slack, and pre-meeting account research, and an @monaco Slack bot to create, run and monitor agents. He says its re-engagement agent gets 25–35% response rates from warm leads that went cold (company claim). No product page or pricing was published.

what_changed.title: Clay describes GTM CI/CD for agent-run sales plays
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, soft). Oct 21: Clay says its GTM engineers now run plays like software. An agent proposes a change, a person approves it, and the Clay CLI deploys it, with every workflow run logged and a snapshot before each edit. Clay says SDR drafting fell from about seven minutes to one, and CLI/API calls reached a million a day within two months of release (company figures). It plans to bring these self-learning loops into the product, with no date given.

what_changed.title: Zoom opens its meeting context to outside agents
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 21 (Zoomtopia): Unified Context Layer, MCP servers across the portfolio, Search & Ask APIs, and ZoomMate Agent Teams are available now. My Notes Workflows into Salesforce are expected in October, and AI Guardrails in Q1 2027.

quiet_note: No first-party news Oct 21–22 from Gong (Gartner MQ Oct 16 still top of press), Outreach (Oct 21 GeekWire mention only), Salesloft or Nooks. Salesforce: no new word on the per-call agent rate, and Agent Optimizer / AI Skills October GA is still not confirmed with 9 days left. Aged off Today: ServiceNow Arc, NVIDIA OpenShell, Different seed, OpenAI on Google Cloud, Anthropic S-1 timing (covered Oct 21).

watch.title: What Monaco's Agent Matrix actually ships
watch.body: So far the detail comes from founder posts: prebuilt and custom agents, a Slack bot to run them, and early access by application. Watch for a product page or docs listing the agents, how they avoid working the same account at once, and whether Agent Matrix is priced separately from the Monaco platform. Also still open: Salesforce's per-call agent rate and Agent Optimizer / AI Skills GA before October ends.

interpretation.fact: Monaco announced Agent Matrix (Oct 21). Clay published its GTM CI/CD approach (Oct 21). Zoom introduced its Unified Context Layer, MCP servers and Search & Ask APIs (Oct 21). OpenAI updated Usage Policies effective Nov 20 to require approval for routers and gateways (Oct 21). Anthropic launched user profiles (Oct 20), enforcement status fields and API version 2026-10-21 (Oct 21), and previewed Claude Duet (Oct 21).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: conversation and CRM data are being exposed through MCP so any agent can act on them, which puts pressure on vendors whose value was owning that data. At the same time, model vendors are pushing accountability down to apps, so a GTM AI app needs per-customer identity and clean audit trails to keep model access.
